instruction: Add a sheet called 'Summary' and build a summary table from cell A1 with bold headers 'Category' and 'Count'. Fill in counts for each Sex (Female, Male), Civil Status (Single, Married, Widow), and Educational Attainment (Elementary, Junior High School, Senior High School) category in the rows below.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a Summary sheet with counts for all demographic categories. Verified counts from complete dataset: Female=17, Male=23, Single=12, Married=11, Widow=17, Elementary=13, Junior High School=15, Senior High School=12. Total respondents=40.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator verifies all 7 instruction requirements (sheet creation, table position, headers, category labels, count values, and bold formatting)
Sheet verification: Getter checks sheet_exists and sheet_name='Summary', metric validates sheet_name=='Summary' (lines 34-38 in metric)
Header verification: Getter extracts A1 and B1 values, metric validates A1='Category' and B1='Count' (lines 40-43 in metric)

Category label verification: Getter extracts cells A2-A9, metric validates against hardcoded expected labels for all 8 categories (Female, Male, Single, Married, Widow, Elementary, Junior High School, Senior High School) at lines 46-60 in metric
Count value verification: Getter extracts cells B2-B9, metric validates against expected values from config (lines 62-72 in metric)
Bold formatting verification: Getter checks if both A1 and B1 have bold font (lines 96-100 in getter), metric validates header_bold==True (lines 74-75 in metric)
Robust logic: All-or-nothing scoring (returns 1.0 only if all requirements pass, 0.0 if any fail), appropriate for this task
Edge case handling: Gracefully handles missing file, non-existent sheet, and missing data by returning 0.0
Correct expected values: Cell values match metadata explanation (Female=17, Male=23, etc.), category labels are semantically correct
Proper postconfig: Includes Ctrl+S to save file before verification, ensuring state is persisted
